title: Link decisions
description: A reviewer's decisions on whether two imported recordings are related: not independent of each other, so every stream cut from them belongs in one encounter group. A decision is about two recordings, not a corpus version, so it carries over to any version that holds them. It is human judgment; no similarity score makes one.

reviewer.description: Who made these decisions: a person or a role the owner recognizes.

x-rules.text: Holds a character other than whitespace: text that is only whitespace is refused.

decisions.description: Decisions in any order. A pair of recordings is decided at most once.

items.description: One decision on one pair of recordings.

sources.description: The two source identities, as a corpus declaration names them, in either order.

decision.description: related: the recordings are not independent and their streams must share one group. unrelated: the reviewer judged them independent, whatever a score says.

note.description: Why, in the reviewer's words. Optional.

x-rules.text: Holds a character other than whitespace: text that is only whitespace is refused.

x-rules.distinct: The two sources of a decision differ.
x-rules.once: A pair of sources, in either order, is decided at most once.
